A '''knowledge cartridge''' plugged into a slot on a [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant as a form of additional storage, complementing the Aj^6's internal memory. They allowed [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] to quickly and easily change the information accessible to them. Cartridges came in two varities, providing either general information or knowledge on specific technical applications.
